summary: Umatilla County, OR steel tower (c.1960, NHLR 1961) on Tiptop Mountain; abandoned, moved off the mountain in 2016, and recorded as a former lookout site.

facts.design: 40-foot steel tower with a 14-by-14 cab (NHLR); earlier L-4 cab on a 15-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Tower taken off the mountain in 2016; the Former Fire Lookout Sites register lists it as a former site, and no tower stands there

staffing.status: Lookouts recorded in 1936, 1942 and 1954; no source gives the date staffing ended

visit.trail_note: No tower stands at the site; no source describes a trail, road or public access

40-foot steel tower with cab erected to replace the 1930s L-4 tower (NHLR and FFLOS)

Tower dismantled and moved off the mountain; re-erected elsewhere with a new cab per Oregon Lookouts and the 2016 FFLA report

corrections.why: The 1961 (or 1959-60) tower is 40 feet (12.2 m) in all three sources. 15.2 m is 50 feet and matches none of them; the 1930s pole tower was 15 feet (about 4.6 m).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says the steel came from Johnson Ridge Lookout; the ODF annual reports quoted by Oregon Lookouts say the Indian Agency's Johnson Creek site. The story follows the contemporaneous ODF reports.
The FFLA 2016 report and Oregon Lookouts say a new cab was put on the moved tower; the Former Fire Lookout Sites register says the cab burned. The story gives both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Removal in 2016 is well sourced by four accounts. Unresolved: build year (ODF completion 1960 via Oregon Lookouts; firelookout.com 1959-1960; NHLR and FFLOS 1961), the cab's fate after the move, and the Long Ridge destination (firelookout.com only; the FFLA report names Long Ridge as a private-land lookout but does not say the tower went there). No source gives an access level, so facts.access is omitted. Name spelled Tiptop by NHLR, FFLOS and firelookout.com, Tip Top by Oregon Lookouts. Elevation matches the brief (4,574 ft, 1,394 m). The brief's height_m 15.2 is proposed as a correction to 12.2. The Cheryl Hill category page mentions a Spring 2016 Lookout Network item on Tiptop, but the cached snippet cut off, so it is not cited. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 6 page reads.
